scene_queue.title: Scene editor
scene_queue.add_current_hint: Stores the prompt, model, resolution and other settings currently in the main window as a new scene.
scene_queue.import_files_hint: Import settings files saved with `File → Save settings`, or NovelAI images (.png/.webp), as scenes. For images the prompt, resolution and so on are read from the metadata. The file name becomes the scene name. You can also drag files onto the table.
scene_queue.update_hint: Replaces the selected scene's settings with the main window's current values. Name and count are kept.
scene_queue.apply_hint: Loads the selected scene's settings into the main window.
scene_queue.interleave: Alternate one image at a time
scene_queue.interleave_hint: Off: scenes run one after another (all of scene 1, then scene 2). On: scenes take turns one image at a time, and a scene drops out once its count is reached.
scene_queue.hint: Only checked scenes run. Drop images or settings files to add scenes and drag rows to reorder. Double-click a prompt or right-click → Edit to change it; press Delete to remove a scene. 🎲 scenes expand wildcards and random syntax anew for every image. Each image waits the generation bar's interval (seconds). Results are saved in a subfolder named after the scene (or the set).
scene_queue.nothing_to_run: There is no scene to run. Add a scene and check it.
scene_queue.dynamic_hint: 🎲 Contains wildcards or random syntax — expanded differently for every image.
scene_queue.edit_prompt_hint: Wildcards (__name__, ##name##), random choices (<a|b>) and artist combos ({artist:group}) work as usual. They are expanded anew for every generated image.
scene_queue.preview_hint: Expand the text of the current tab once, as for one generated image. Each click draws again.
scene_queue.preview_placeholder: Click Preview to see an expanded result here.
scene_queue.single_folder_hint: When on, every scene's results go into one folder named after the set instead of one folder per scene. The set name is the name of the set file (.json) you last saved or loaded.
